title: Existence of smooth-functorial saturated resolution of finite fine fans
statement: There exists a smooth-functorial saturated desingularization $\mathcal R$ of fine torsion-free fans with finite affine covers [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup]. Thus $\mathcal R(F)$ is a finite tower of saturated blowups along nonempty coherent monoid ideals with smooth last fan, and for a smooth morphism $g:G\to F$, $\mathcal R(G)$ is canonically the contraction of $g^*\mathcal R(F)$, retaining the centers and their order. The identifications respect composition and apply also to open localizations, isomorphisms, and inclusions into finite disjoint unions.
